attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Firewall (T1562.007)
attackers_goals: Bypass network security controls to gain access to restricted cloud resources.
description: A cloud identity created or modified a security group.
investigative_actions: Check which security rules were added or modified. Check whether the identity that modified the security group rules is permitted to perform such action. Check which cloud resources can be affected by the security group.
name: A cloud identity created or modified a security group

variations.attackers_goals: Bypass network security controls to gain access to restricted cloud resources.
variations.investigative_actions: Check which security rules were added or modified. Check whether the identity that modified the security group rules is permitted to perform such action. Check which cloud resources can be affected by the security group.
